payload.summary: Keep uploaded-local retrieval fail-closed; reconcile application and database scope declarations
payload.detail: REVALIDATED 2026-10-23 at df1e07db04. Preserve fail-closed uploaded-local retrieval. Remaining scope is application/database scope consistency, not enabling retrieval or blaming unrelated canary failures. Source inspection only; no fresh application/provider execution or clinical sign-off. Evidence: src/lib/rag/rag-candidate-sources.ts. PRIOR DETAIL: OWNER DECISION 2026-09-26 (Josh, 'all as recommended' in the project chat): keep uploaded-local retrieval fail-closed for now; turning it on is a separate, larger safety project (P16 generation-bound activation). Canary cases are NOT red because of this: #4WR2XZ's live search found the WA clozapine guidelines scoped public, so do not re-investigate that link. Remaining cleanup only: the app still treats uploaded_local (and international_supplementary, fail-closed by migration 20260901130000) as live scopes in src/lib/rag/rag-candidate-sources.ts, rag-governed-search.ts, source-conflict-section.ts and rag-reviewed-policy-input.ts while match_governed_candidate_chunks_v3 returns nothing for them; making app and database agree is a RAG-surface change needing the usual flag and canary. DO NOT route around the fail-closed migration.
